operations.name: researchMarket
operations.description: Research the idea's market on the live web: competitors and their gaps, customer complaints, willingness to pay, three customer segments with a recommended first one, and a business model (as hypotheses). Pass what the founder just said as notes, and the product's site as website. Reuses research under a week old unless refresh is true. Uses your OpenAI key; takes about a minute.

operations.name: findProspects
operations.description: Find real companies that might buy, for the chosen segment (default: the recommended one), each with evidence of need, an explainable score and what is still unverified. Uses Apollo.io when the server has it, otherwise web search; websites are checked. more=true adds to the current list; exclude skips companies by name. About a minute.
operations.selection: { ideaId stage summary segment notePath demo limitations updatedAt speakingTip data }

operations.name: excludeProspects

operations.selection: { ideaId stage summary segment notePath demo limitations updatedAt speakingTip data }

operations.name: saveCustomerDiscovery

Every prospect needs a source URL; unsourced findings are stored as hypotheses.

operations.name: createOutreachEmailDrafts
operations.description: Save the prepared emails (all, or the names/ids given) as drafts in the person's connected Gmail. Never sends; emails already in Gmail are not duplicated. Ask first. Without a Gmail connection nothing is saved: every email in customer_discovery has a compose_url ("Open in Gmail") that opens it pre-filled in the person's own Gmail.
operations.selection: { ideaId stage summary segment notePath demo limitations updatedAt speakingTip data }

operations.name: createGoal

Runs what it can at once; tier 2+ steps wait for approval. Only for real commitments, not ideas being explored. An active goal with the same title is returned instead of a duplicate (existing: true).

operations.name: startOutreachGoal

operations.name: advanceGoal

operations.name: decideApproval

fields.name: kind
fields.description: bug, enhancement, improvement or feedback (about Manifest, not the person's idea).

fields.name: title
fields.description: A short issue title in plain words, e.g. 'Pitch deck export fails on Safari'.

fields.name: details
fields.description: What happened or what they want, in the person's words. Posted publicly; no names, emails or private details.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where it came from: voice, app, agent or cli.

fields.name: duplicateOf
fields.description: Issue number this is the same as (from an earlier possible_duplicates answer).

fields.name: forceNew
fields.description: True when none of the possible duplicates is the same thing.
